title: The Jacobian is the area scale factor
caption: x = u + v, y = u − v sends the unit square in the (u, v) plane to a tilted square in the (x, y) plane. The Jacobian determinant is 1 × (−1) − 1 × 1 = −2: areas double (the minus sign records that orientation flips), so dA = 2 du dv.
alt: The unit square with corners (0, 0), (1, 0), (1, 1), (0, 1) and its image with corners (0, 0), (1, 1), (2, 0), (1, −1), twice the area.
description: The corners (u, v) of the unit square map to (u + v, u − v).
The image has corners (0, 0), (1, 1), (2, 0), (1, −1): a square rotated 45° and enlarged by √2.

checks.name: the image has 2 times the area: |J| = |1 × (−1) − 1 × 1| = 2
